items.title: Spooky New Infostealer Malware Uses AI to ‘Autodox’ Victims
items.summary: Named “Volta-Autodoxer,” the recently uncovered malware uses AI tools to collect troves of data about victims, from login credentials and credit card numbers to Discord sessions and UberEats receipts.
items.author: Lily Hay Newman, Matt Burgess

items.title: Meta’s Muse Could Upend All Kinds of Businesses. It Hasn’t Yet
items.summary: Companies have spent the past several weeks trying to reassure investors that Muse and other AI agents pose more of an opportunity than a threat.
items.author: Paresh Dave

items.title: An AI Agent Injected Drugs Into a Live Mouse’s Brain
items.summary: A biotech startup let an agent choose a gene therapy and successfully inject the treatment, offering a startling glimpse of the future of research labs.
items.author: Emily Mullin
